facts.text: The hotel is at the heart of Pittsburgh's business, theater and retail hub, within walking distance of Market Square.
facts.excerpt: Located at the heart of the city's business, theater, and retail hub, and within walking distance to Market Square

facts.text: Guest rooms have views of landmarks such as Mt. Washington or PNC Park.
facts.excerpt: Look out for landmarks such as Mt. Washington or PNC Park while you relax over freshly brewed coffee or selections from the in-room refreshment center.

facts.text: The Deluxe Mt. rooms are on floors 20-23 and have floor-to-ceiling windows with panoramic views of Mt. Washington over the city skyline.
facts.excerpt: Newly refreshed guestroom located on floors 20-23. Features floor-to-ceiling windows with panoramic views of Mt. Washington peering over the city skyline.

facts.text: The Harris One Bedroom Suite is at the end of the 20th guest floor and has a kitchenette and a full-sized refrigerator.
facts.excerpt: located at the end of our 20th guest floor. Features 1.5 baths, kitchenette and full-sized refrigerator.

facts.text: The Presidential Suite has a design inspired by Pittsburgh's natural elements, a marble entry foyer and hard wood floors.
facts.excerpt: our Presidential Suite features a renovated design inspired by Pittsburgh's natural elements, a marble entry foyer, 1.5 baths, hard wood floors

facts.text: The Signature One Bedroom Suite is a corner suite described as ideal for families, with a living room with sofa bed, a dining nook and two full bathrooms.
facts.excerpt: corner suite ideal for families featuring a spacious living room with sofa bed, a cozy dining nook, and two full bathrooms.

facts.text: The hotel's restaurant is fl.2, serving modern American food.
There is an on-site Starbucks at the hotel.
facts.excerpt: Start your day at the on-site Starbucks® at Fairmont Pittsburgh.

facts.text: The gym has floor-to-ceiling windows with downtown views.
facts.excerpt: Dynamic downtown views from floor-to-ceiling windows energize you during a cardio workout in the 6,000sqft gym.

facts.text: The spa has a dry cedar sauna and an eucalyptus steam room.
facts.excerpt: Complete your wellness journey with a session in a dry cedar sauna or eucalyptus steam room.

facts.text: The hotel has a Les Clefs d'Or concierge.
facts.excerpt: is proud to be the only hotel in Pittsburgh with a **Les Clefs d'Or** Concierge.

facts.text: Pets of all sizes are welcome for a nightly fee of $60, and must stay on a leash and not be left unattended in guest rooms.
facts.excerpt: Fairmont Pittsburgh welcomes pets of all sizes for a nightly fee of $60. Pets must remain on a leash at all times and may not be left unattended in guest rooms.

facts.text: Valet parking and an on-site self-parking garage are available, both for an additional fee.
facts.excerpt: Valet parking is available for an additional charge. Guests may also take advantage of our on-site self-parking garage, available at an additional fee.

facts.text: Condé Nast Traveler lists the hotel in its Readers' Choice Awards for 2017 and 2026.
Deluxe Ballpark View rooms have floor-to-ceiling windows with views of PNC Park, a soaking tub and a separate walk-in shower.
facts.excerpt: Newly refreshed guestroom with floor-to-ceiling windows and views of PNC Park. Guest bathroom features a relaxing soaking tub and separate walk-in shower.
